NativePerson.name: Native Person
NativePerson.definition: Person for which a birth place is specified.

System.name: System
System.definition: System for which a location is specified.

DomiciledParty.name: Domiciled Party
DomiciledParty.definition: Party which is domiciled in a specific location.

OperatingOrganisation.name: Operating Organisation
OperatingOrganisation.definition: Organisation which has its operations in a specific location.

Address.name: Address
Address.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address.

IssuedDocument.name: Issued Document
IssuedDocument.definition: Document which was issued at a specific location.

DepartureTransportParameters.name: Departure Transport Parameters
DepartureTransportParameters.definition: Transport parameters linked to a place of departure.

DestinationTransportParameters.name: Destination Transport Parameters
DestinationTransportParameters.definition: Transport parameters linked to a place of destination.

InsuranceCertificate.name: Insurance Certificate
InsuranceCertificate.definition: Insurance for which the claims are payable at a specific location.

Party.name: Party
Party.definition: Party which resides in a specific location.

RelatedExpiry.name: Related Expiry
RelatedExpiry.definition: Expiry information which contains an expiry location.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the location, for instance, the name of an airport, a county, a state, a province or a city by a code or a text. eg LHR for London Heathrow airport.

TaxableParty.name: Taxable Party
TaxableParty.definition: Party which is taxable at a specific location

RegisteredOrganisation.name: Registered Organisation
RegisteredOrganisation.definition: Organisation which is registered at that location.

RelatedTransport.name: Related Transport
RelatedTransport.definition: Transport process for which a transit location is specified.

TimeZone.name: Time Zone
TimeZone.definition: Offset of the time before or after 00:00 hour UTC.
